steps.name: Install dependencies
steps.run: if [ -f requirements.txt ]; then pip install -r requirements.txt; fi

steps.name: Docker build
steps.run:
if [ -f docker-compose.yml ] || [ -f docker-compose.yaml ]; then
  docker compose build
fi

steps.name: Docker login & push
steps.run:
if [ -z "$DOCKER_TOKEN" ]; then
  echo "DOCKER_TOKEN not set — skipping Docker push"
  exit 0
fi
REPO_NAME="${{ github.event.repository.name }}"
echo "$DOCKER_TOKEN" | docker login -u "$DOCKER_USERNAME" --password-stdin
if [ -f docker-compose.yml ] || [ -f docker-compose.yaml ]; then
  sed -i "s|image:.*|image: $DOCKER_USERNAME/$REPO_NAME:latest|" docker-compose.yml docker-compose.yaml 2>/dev/null || true
  docker compose build
  docker compose push
fi

steps.name: Deploy (optional)
steps.run: echo "No deployment configured — add your deploy command here."
